messages.author: 173f43def21b45ab
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] How to use our R package in Shinyspps?
parts:
Thanks Tareef once again. After reading the first written tutorial and reading some blogs, I've finally just now was able to publish our R app to the shinyapps.io, thanks for your tips.

Few notes/experience to share:
  • Had to change our R package output to dataTable format from text to get a meaningful result in the UI
  • Had to upload our code to GitHub and use devTools::install_github('path-to-our-repository') to install our created R package to Shinyapps, local copies of the files wouldn't work. Got the tip from: https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/shiny-discuss/l6nug9hMh7g
Thanks!
--Ishti
